content.text:
I added `"rotateCW"` using the existing clockwise rotation, which tries shifts of 0, −1, +1, −2, +2 columns and otherwise leaves the piece unchanged. I kept `"rotate"` working as well. Locking now follows your rule: 2 ticks of lock delay, a left/right move while resting restarts it at most 3 times per piece, falling clears the ticks but not the restart count, and hard drop locks at once. I only checked that the script parses; I didn't run the game.

Rejected: counting a sideways move as a restart when no lock tick has passed yet (it would use up the cap for nothing), and letting rotation restart the delay (your rule names only left/right).
